lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He let the key where?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: On the floor. He dropped it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How do you know that? How do you know that Brendan?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I was there that day.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You were there the day he dropped it? And what day was that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: November 2nd.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he show you the key that day?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well then how do you know he dropped it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I seen 'em pulling his dresser drawer and I seen it in his hands.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, and what else did you see? So you're in the bedroom with him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No, (shakes head "no") I'm sittin' on the couch.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You can't see the dresser from the couch, can you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well before he had, he had the room different.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You're startin to lie again, aren't ya?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz he had the bed where that window is.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He had the bed where the window was when Teresa was there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did he move the stuff around?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So, could you draw out where the key was, or well let's just go back to the key. You said you see him take it out of the dresser?
